description: Submit image work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery. Creative baseline: unless the user declined, build at least one dopamine hook from dopamine_hooks_get into this prompt, script or sound. First call image_models_get. Present dated original-model Arena scores (not scores of our quantized/LoRA recipes), traits, availability and native alternatives to help the user choose. Select one model; never invent agreement or substitute user consent for the operator's hosting permission. For quality-first image generation or editing, prefer the connected agent’s own image tool when it supports the requested operation, for example ChatGPT image generation and image editing. Check what this client actually exposes, including in Claude. Honor the user’s chosen provider. For anime-style character illustration, HiruAI Image offers WAI Illustrious SDXL v17 when available in image_models_get.

inputSchema.description: Create one 1024x1024 image from one selected model. Read image_models_get and explain quality evidence and applicable consent before selection. Existing older paired results remain readable. Prompt 3–2000 characters.

acknowledge_adult.description: Confirm that the requesting user meets the adult-use requirement.

acknowledge_model_terms.description: Use true only after actual user authorization for the selected model. User consent never grants the platform hosting rights.

acknowledge_no_real_person.description: Confirm the prompt and inputs do not depict or imitate a real person for adult content.

acknowledge_noncommercial.description: Use true only after actual user authorization for the selected model. User consent never grants the platform hosting rights.

acknowledge_nsfw_policy.description: Confirm the user accepts the selected model’s adult-content restrictions.

acknowledge_privacy.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_rights.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended operation. Reuse on network retries.

model.description: One model per new request; Qwen Image 2512 Q4 + Lightning (8-step) is the default. The separate 50-step quality model remains selectable. Read image_models_get first and present dated quality evidence, strengths, availability and native alternatives; no Lightning Arena score is measured. Creator-restricted choices require recorded hosting permission.

model_terms_version.description: Current catalog version from image_models_get, required with creator model terms.

nsfw_requested.description: Legacy alias selecting only Z-Image Turbo NSFW. Prefer model; never request two models together.

prompt.description: Image prompt, 3–2000 characters. Whitespace is collapsed before backend length/safety checks.
examples: A playful orange astronaut cat DJ on the Moon, cinematic mint lighting.
